title: ACOS Pre-Engineering (Unix) — Component Tree
description: A recursive tree of independently human-testable, output-generating components that, wired together through their contracts, fulfill the product vision. Every node — leaf AND intermediate — is a real functional unit with its own acceptance criteria and verifier. Variable depth: a branch stops only when a component is atomic-testable (small enough to build directly while still producing an observable, independently checkable output).

vision_ref.description: Path to vision.md for this feature.

verifier_vocabulary.description: The closed set of verifier types this product uses. Domain-agnostic — pick what fits the product. New types may be added here, but every node.verifier.type MUST be one of these.

hardening.description: Config for the per-component code-hardening gate run by /acos-synthesis-protocol. The gate embeds a SCOPED acos-robust-code-review loop on each eligible leaf BEFORE it is marked passed, so latent code defects (silent failures, edge cases, security) are removed at the leaf — where they are cheapest — instead of being composed into parents. Optional: when absent the runtime applies the documented defaults, so trees generated before this field existed still build.

code_verifier_types.description: Which verifier types denote CODE artifacts that get the review gate. Non-code types (document-render, blueprint-constraint, visual-diff, measurement, manual-only) are never code-reviewed — this is what preserves the skill's domain-agnostic claim.

default_max_rounds.description: Review → fix → re-review rounds per component before remaining sub-gate findings are escalated to the punch-list. Small by design: a single component artifact converges fast.

default_severity_gate.description: Block integration until zero findings AT OR ABOVE this severity. Findings strictly below it are routed to the punch-list instead of hard-blocking the climb on cosmetics.

id.description: Stable unique id, e.g. C-014. Never reused across rebuilds.

path.description: Slash path from root, e.g. rocket/engine/gimbal/servo-motor. Human-readable lineage.

tier_label.description: Human-friendly level label (e.g. 'module', 'part', 'sub-part'). FREE-FORM and variable — the tree is NOT fixed to 4 levels. Purely cosmetic; depth is authoritative.

parent.description: Mother-component id. null only for the depth-0 root.

children.description: Child component ids. Empty array = LEAF (atomic-testable; built directly, not decomposed further).

purpose.description: What this component IS and is supposed to DO — one or two sentences.

single_responsibility.description: The ONE thing this component does well (Unix philosophy). If you cannot state it in one clause, the component is doing too much — split it.

output_artifact.description: The observable thing a human can SEE/RUN to judge this component. Every node must produce one — this is the invariant that bans 'mindless parts'.

kind.description: Domain-agnostic output kind, e.g. software | document | blueprint | data | media | hardware-spec | service | other.

description.description: Concretely, what does running/building this component yield that a human inspects?

location_hint.description: Where the built artifact is expected to land (path, URL, physical spec doc). Optional at plan time.

contract.description: The component's interface — its 'pipes'. Defines composability and how it plugs into the mother component.

from_component.description: id of a sibling/child component that supplies this input, if any.

connects_to_parent_via.description: Plain-language: how this component's output plugs into the mother component. For the root, describe how the assembled outputs realize the vision.

verifier.description: PLUGGABLE per-component test. The type drives both the auto-check the runtime attempts and the human-test instructions the Component Library renders.

type.description: MUST be a member of verifier_vocabulary.

auto_check.description: What the system runs without a human. If the verifier type cannot be machine-checked, set runnable=false and rely on human_test.

method.description: Command, script path, render call, schema-validate, dimensional check, etc. Concrete enough to execute. Empty if runnable=false.

expected.description: The pass condition the auto-check asserts.

human_test.description: How a human picks this component at random and verifies it themselves. ALWAYS present, even when auto_check.runnable=true (defense in depth).

procedure.description: Ordered steps a non-author can follow.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specific, measurable, independently checkable. Each must be judgeable against THIS component's output alone — not the whole product.

reusable.description: Can this component be reused by other parents / other products?

tags.description: Capability tags for a reuse search, e.g. ['motor','actuator','pid-loop'].

known_consumers.description: Component ids (possibly in other trees) that already reuse this.

build_order_index.description: Filled by unix.buildplan. Lower = built earlier (leaves first). null until buildplan runs.

hardening.description: Per-component override + result record for the code-hardening gate. 'enabled'/'max_rounds'/'severity_gate' are optional plan-time overrides; 'state'/'rounds'/'open_findings'/'punchlist_ref' are written at run time by set-status.py. Absent ⇒ runtime derives eligibility (leaf AND verifier.type ∈ hardening.code_verifier_types).

enabled.description: Force the gate on/off for this component. null/absent ⇒ runtime derives.

state.description: Run-time result. clean = zero findings at/above the gate. punchlist = gate-severity clean with lower findings deferred. skipped = not eligible (non-code artifact or a composing parent).

open_findings.description: Count of unresolved findings AT OR ABOVE the severity gate at the time of the verdict (should be 0 for clean/punchlist).

punchlist_ref.description: Path (relative to feature-dir) of the deferred sub-gate findings, if any.

status.description: Lifecycle status, updated by /acos-synthesis-protocol. 'planned' at decompose time. 'passed' requires its verifier to have asserted pass AND — for a hardening-eligible code leaf — the hardening gate to have reached state clean|punchlist (set-status enforces this; exit 4 otherwise). A parent cannot pass until all children passed AND its own composed verifier passed.

evidence_ref.description: Path to the evidence bundle recorded when this component was built/verified. null until built.
